title: AAPCS64 homogeneous floating point aggregates passable via vector registers
summary: An HFA has at most four elements and can be passed in multiple floating-point registers when enough are available.
applies: AArch64; general call and register representation of AAPCS64
detail: A structure composed of three floats can correspond to three consecutive S registers. You cannot judge the structure content by just looking at one X register.
boundary: Mixing in integer members generally no longer satisfies the HFA; insufficient parameter registers change the pass location.
relevance: Identify whether multiple floating point inputs in disassembly come from a source-level structure parameter.
